findings.title: Critical CVE in container image
findings.remediation: Update the base image/package or apply a patch.

findings.title: cluster-admin binding overuse
findings.remediation: Restrict cluster-admin; use specific scoped roles.

findings.title: Secret exposed in environment variable
findings.remediation: Use Kubernetes Secrets with volume mounts.

findings.title: Orphan / dead service (no endpoints)
findings.remediation: Delete the service or fix its selector.

findings.title: Missing NetworkPolicy
findings.remediation: Define a NetworkPolicy for each namespace.
